var useDevCenterUpdater = ({
  siteId,
  base,
  serverLocalUrl,
  serverExposedUrl,
  devMetadata
}) => {
  const devCenterWatcher = (0, import_react4.useMemo)(() => new DevCenterWatcher(), []);
  const [versionOverrideId, setVersionOverrideId] = (0, import_react4.useState)();
  const [manifest, setManifest] = (0, import_react4.useState)(null);

  const writeToDebugLog = useDebugLog();
  const exit = useExit();

  } = useProjectModel();

  const [tunnelRequired, setTunnelRequired] = (0, import_react4.useState)(false);
  const fetchAppManifest = useFetchAppManifest({ base });
  const baseUrl = serverExposedUrl ?? serverLocalUrl;
  const updateDevCenter = (0, import_react4.useCallback)(
    async (latestManifest, isTunnelRequired2) => {
      const manifestUpdateResult = checkManifestForChanges(
        manifest,
        latestManifest
      );
      if ((0, import_variant2.isType)(manifestUpdateResult, "Unchanged")) {
        return manifestUpdateResult;
      }
      if (!serverExposedUrl && !tunnelUrl.current && isTunnelRequired2) {
        const config2 = await readUserConfig();
        if (!config2.tunneling) {
          setTunnelRequired(true);
          return ManifestUpdateResult.Unchanged();
        }
        const serverLocalPort = parseInt(new URL(serverLocalUrl).port, 10);
        const tunnel = await openTunnel(serverLocalPort);
        tunnelUrl.current = tunnel.url;
        return ManifestUpdateResult.Unchanged();
      }
      const appConfig = await readAppConfig(projectFolder, writeToDebugLog);
      let updatedVersionOverrideId = appConfig?.devArmTag;
      if (!updatedVersionOverrideId) {
        updatedVersionOverrideId = await devCenterOverrides.createComponentsOverride({
          type: OverrideType.DEV,
          appId: config.appId,
          appManifest: latestManifest,
          projectId: releaseAppId,
          lifecycleState: overrideLifecycleState
        });
      } else {
        const updateState = await devCenterOverrides.updateComponentsOverrides({
          id: updatedVersionOverrideId,
          type: OverrideType.DEV,
          appId: config.appId,
          appManifest: latestManifest,
          projectId: releaseAppId
        });
        if (!(0, import_variant2.isType)(updateState, "Updated")) {
          updatedVersionOverrideId = await devCenterOverrides.createComponentsOverride({
            type: OverrideType.DEV,
            appId: config.appId,
            appManifest: latestManifest,
            projectId: releaseAppId,
            lifecycleState: overrideLifecycleState
          });
        }
      }
      if (updatedVersionOverrideId !== appConfig?.devArmTag) {
        await saveAppConfig(projectFolder, {
          devArmTag: updatedVersionOverrideId
        });
      }
      setManifest(latestManifest);
      setVersionOverrideId(updatedVersionOverrideId);
      devCenterWatcher.emit("manifestUpdated", {
        versionOverrideId: updatedVersionOverrideId,
        updatedComponents: manifestUpdateResult.updatedComponents
      });
      return manifestUpdateResult;
    },
    [
      config.appId,
      releaseAppId,
      manifest,
      serverLocalUrl,

// ../cli-site-old/src/preview/useCreatePreview.ts

var import_react2 = __toESM(require_react(), 1);
function useCreatePreview() {
  const { model } = useProjectModel();
  const veloClient = useVeloClient();
  const dmClient = useDocumentManagementClient();
  return (0, import_react2.useCallback)(
    async (previewSource) => {
      const deploymentSourceData = await getDeploymentSourceData(
        model,
        previewSource === "local" ? DeploymentSource.local() : DeploymentSource.remote()
      );
      const preview = await veloClient.deploySitePreview(deploymentSourceData);
      return {
        deploymentId: preview.deploymentId,
        previewUrl: preview.deploymentShortUrl ?? preview.deploymentUrl,
        deploymentStatus: preview.isPublishPipelineDeployment ? await dmClient.getDeploymentDetails(preview.deploymentId) : DeploymentStatus.Success()
      };
    },
    [dmClient, model, veloClient]
  );
}

var PublishCommand = ({ approvePreview, force }) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const createPreview = useCreatePreview();
  const { publishDeployment } = useDocumentManagementClient();
  const publishDeploymentAction = useAsyncCallback(
    async (_, deploymentId) => publishDeployment(deploymentId)
  );
  const { status } = useAsync(async () => {
    const preview = await createPreview();
    const preApprovePreview = force || ((0, import_variant.isType)(preview.deploymentStatus, DeploymentStatus.Success) ? approvePreview : false);
    if (preApprovePreview) {
      void publishDeploymentAction.execute(preview.deploymentId);
    }

      preApprovePreview

  createDraftVersion = async (appId, tag) => {
    try {
      const { data } = await this.httpClient.request(
        commitComponentOverride({
          appId,
          componentOverrideId: tag
        })
      );
      return commitComponentOverrideSchema.parse(data);
    } catch (cause) {
      throw new CliError({
        cause,
        code: CliErrorCode.FailedToCreateDraftVersion()
      });

  };
  releaseDraftVersion = async (appId, options) => {
    try {
      const { data } = await this.httpClient.request(
        promoteAppVersionFromDraftToProduction({
          appId,
          createNewMajor: options.createNewMajor,
          latestMajor: options.latestMajor,
          notes: options.notes
        })
      );
      const { fullVersion } = promoteAppVersionFromDraftToProductionSchema.parse(data);
      return { releasedVersion: fullVersion };
    } catch (cause) {
      throw new CliError({
        cause,
        code: CliErrorCode.FailedToReleaseDraftVersion()
      });
    }
  };
  releaseHeadlessProject = async ({
    appId,
    comment,
    componentOverrideId,
    createMinorVersion
  }) => {
    try {
      const { data } = await this.httpClient.request(

          appId,
          componentOverrideId,
          createMinorVersion,
          notes: comment

function useARMClient() {

  const client = (0, import_react.useMemo)(() => new ARMClient(httpClient), [httpClient]);
  return usePanoramaMethodLogger(client);
}

// ../cli-astro-commands/src/components/ReleaseCommand/ReleaseSite.tsx
var ReleaseSite = ({
  baseUrl,
  label,
  createMinorVersion,
  comment
}) => {
  const { appId, siteId } = useSiteConfig();
  const { getAppProject } = useBackendAsAServiceClient();
  const { releaseHeadlessProject } = useARMClient();
  const updateDeploymentTopology = useUpdateDeploymentTopologyForSite(siteId);
  const releaseAction = useAsyncCallback(
    async (_, previewId, previewUrl) => {
      const deploymentBaseUrl = await releaseHeadlessProject({
        appId,
        componentOverrideId: previewId,
        createMinorVersion,
        comment
      });
      await updateDeploymentTopology({
        environment: "production",
        siteUrl: previewUrl ?? "",
        versionOverrideId: previewId
      });
      const appProject = await getAppProject(appId);
      return { baseUrl: appProject?.customDomain?.domain ?? deploymentBaseUrl };
    }
  );
  const { uploadStatus } = useCreatePreview({
    baseUrl,
    label,
    onPreviewCreated: ({ previewId, deployment: { deploymentUrl } }) => {
      void releaseAction.execute(previewId, deploymentUrl);
    }
  });
  return /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(import_react2.default.Fragment, null, /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(
    ActionStatus,
    {
      status: uploadStatus,
      loadingText: "Uploading your application files...",
      successText: "Uploaded successfully!"
    }
  ), (0, import_variant2.match)(releaseAction.status, {
    NotRequested: () => null,
    Error: () => null,
    Loading: () => /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(Spinner, { text: /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(Text, null, "Releasing...") }),
    Success: ({ result: { baseUrl: baseUrl2 } }) => /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(Box_default, { flexDirection: "column", gap: 1 }, /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(Alert, { type: "success" }, /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(Text, { bold: true }, "Site published on ", baseUrl2)))
  }));
};

  releaseDraftVersion = async (appId, options) => {
    try {

        promoteAppVersionFromDraftToProduction({
          appId,
          createNewMajor: options.createNewMajor,
          latestMajor: options.latestMajor,
          notes: options.notes
        })

      });
    }
  };

    appId,

    componentOverrideId,
    createMinorVersion

          appId,
          componentOverrideId,
          createMinorVersion,
          notes: comment
        })
      );
      return releaseSchema.parse(data).releaseBaseUrl;
    } catch (e) {
      throw new CliError({

      const { fullVersion } = promoteAppVersionFromDraftToProductionSchema.parse(data);
      return { releasedVersion: fullVersion };
    } catch (cause) {
      throw new CliError({
        cause,
        code: CliErrorCode.FailedToReleaseDraftVersion()
      });
    }
  };
  releaseHeadlessProject = async ({
    appId,
    comment,
    componentOverrideId,
    createMinorVersion
  }) => {
    try {
      const { data } = await this.httpClient.request(
        release({
          appId,
          componentOverrideId,
          createMinorVersion,
          notes: comment
        })
      );
      return releaseSchema.parse(data).releaseBaseUrl;
    } catch (e) {
      throw new CliError({
        cause: e,
        code: CliErrorCode.FailedToReleaseHeadlessProject()
      });
    }
  };
};

// ../arm-client/src/useARMClient.ts
init_esm_shims();
var import_react = __toESM(require_react(), 1);
function useARMClient() {
  const httpClient = useHttpClient({ type: "backoffice" });
  const client = (0, import_react.useMemo)(() => new ARMClient(httpClient), [httpClient]);
  return usePanoramaMethodLogger(client);
}

// ../cli-astro-commands/src/components/ReleaseCommand/ReleaseSite.tsx
var ReleaseSite = ({
  baseUrl,
  label,
  createMinorVersion,
  comment
}) => {
  const { appId, siteId } = useSiteConfig();
  const { getAppProject } = useBackendAsAServiceClient();
  const { releaseHeadlessProject } = useARMClient();
  const updateDeploymentTopology = useUpdateDeploymentTopologyForSite(siteId);
  const releaseAction = useAsyncCallback(
    async (_, previewId, previewUrl) => {
      const deploymentBaseUrl = await releaseHeadlessProject({
        appId,
        componentOverrideId: previewId,
        createMinorVersion,
        comment
      });
      await updateDeploymentTopology({
        environment: "production",
        siteUrl: previewUrl ?? "",
        versionOverrideId: previewId
      });
      const appProject = await getAppProject(appId);
      return { baseUrl: appProject?.customDomain?.domain ?? deploymentBaseUrl };
    }
  );
  const { uploadStatus } = useCreatePreview({
    baseUrl,
    label,
    onPreviewCreated: ({ previewId, deployment: { deploymentUrl } }) => {
      void releaseAction.execute(previewId, deploymentUrl);
    }
  });
  return /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(import_react2.default.Fragment, null, /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(
    ActionStatus,
    {
      status: uploadStatus,
      loadingText: "Uploading your application files...",
      successText: "Uploaded successfully!"
    }
  ), (0, import_variant2.match)(releaseAction.status, {
    NotRequested: () => null,
    Error: () => null,
    Loading: () => /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(Spinner, { text: /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(Text, null, "Releasing...") }),
    Success: ({ result: { baseUrl: baseUrl2 } }) => /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(Box_default, { flexDirection: "column", gap: 1 }, /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(Alert, { type: "success" }, /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(Text, { bold: true }, "Site published on ", baseUrl2)))
  }));

// ../cli-astro-commands/src/components/ReleaseCommand/ReleaseSite.tsx
var ReleaseSite = ({
  baseUrl,
  label,
  createMinorVersion,
  comment
}) => {
  const { appId, siteId } = useSiteConfig();
  const { getAppProject } = useBackendAsAServiceClient();
  const { releaseHeadlessProject } = useARMClient();
  const updateDeploymentTopology = useUpdateDeploymentTopologyForSite(siteId);
  const releaseAction = useAsyncCallback(
    async (_, previewId, previewUrl) => {
      const deploymentBaseUrl = await releaseHeadlessProject({
        appId,
        componentOverrideId: previewId,
        createMinorVersion,
        comment
      });
      await updateDeploymentTopology({
        environment: "production",
        siteUrl: previewUrl ?? "",
        versionOverrideId: previewId
      });
      const appProject = await getAppProject(appId);
      return { baseUrl: appProject?.customDomain?.domain ?? deploymentBaseUrl };
    }
  );
  const { uploadStatus } = useCreatePreview({
    baseUrl,
    label,
    onPreviewCreated: ({ previewId, deployment: { deploymentUrl } }) => {
      void releaseAction.execute(previewId, deploymentUrl);
    }
  });
  return /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(import_react2.default.Fragment, null, /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(
    ActionStatus,
    {
      status: uploadStatus,
      loadingText: "Uploading your application files...",
      successText: "Uploaded successfully!"
    }
  ), (0, import_variant2.match)(releaseAction.status, {
    NotRequested: () => null,
    Error: () => null,
    Loading: () => /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(Spinner, { text: /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(Text, null, "Releasing...") }),
    Success: ({ result: { baseUrl: baseUrl2 } }) => /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(Box_default, { flexDirection: "column", gap: 1 }, /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(Alert, { type: "success" }, /* @__PURE__ */ import_react2.default.createElement(Text, { bold: true }, "Site published on ", baseUrl2)))
  }));

  const updateDeploymentTopology = useUpdateDeploymentTopologyForSite(siteId);
  const releaseAction = useAsyncCallback(
    async (_, previewId, previewUrl) => {
      const deploymentBaseUrl = await releaseHeadlessProject({
        appId,
        componentOverrideId: previewId,
        createMinorVersion,
        comment
      });
      await updateDeploymentTopology({
        environment: "production",
        siteUrl: previewUrl ?? "",
        versionOverrideId: previewId
      });
      const appProject = await getAppProject(appId);
      return { baseUrl: appProject?.customDomain?.domain ?? deploymentBaseUrl };
    }
  );

      _getV4AcquireCommand() {

          return function patchAcquire() {
            const nSessionsBeforeAcquire = this.sessions.length;
            const session = original.call(this);
            const nSessionsAfterAcquire = this.sessions.length;
            if (nSessionsBeforeAcquire === nSessionsAfterAcquire) {

// ../cli-http-client/src/error-info.ts

function getHttpErrorInfo(httpError) {
  return {
    request: {
      baseURL: httpError.config.baseURL,
      url: httpError.config.url,
      method: httpError.config.method,
      headers: httpError.config.headers,
      data: httpError.config.data
    },
    response: {
      code: httpError.code,
      message: httpError.message,
      status: httpError.response?.status,
      headers: httpError.response?.headers,
      data: httpError.response?.data
    }
  };
}

var {
  InvalidResponseData,
  FailedToGetAuthToken,
  FailedToGetDeviceCode,
  FailedToRenewAuthToken,
  FailedToRenewAuthTokenSiteNotFound,
  FailedToRevokeRefreshToken
} = CliErrorCode;
var clientId = "6f95cec8-3e98-48b9-b4e5-1fb92fcd9973";
var getCurrentTimestamp = () => Math.floor(Date.now() / 1e3);
var DeviceCodeNotYetVerifiedError = class extends Error {
};
var RenewTokenData = (0, import_variant.variant)({
  TokenRenewed: (0, import_variant.payload)(),
  RefreshTokenRevoked: (0, import_variant.fields)()
});
var AuthClient = class {
  constructor(httpClient) {
    this.httpClient = httpClient;
    const { minRetryTimeout } = getTestOverrides();
    this.retryOptions = {
      retries: 3,
      minTimeout: minRetryTimeout,
      maxTimeout: 3 * 1e3
    };
  }
  retryOptions;
  async requestDeviceCode(req = {}) {
    try {
      const { data } = await pRetry(
        () => this.httpClient.request(deviceCode({ ...req, clientId })),
        this.retryOptions
      );
      return deviceCodeSchema.parse(data);
    } catch (error) {
      throw new CliError({
        code: FailedToGetDeviceCode(),
        cause: error
      });
    }
  }
  async createToken(req) {
    try {
      const payload4 = {
        clientId,
        grantType: "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code",
        scope: "offline_access",
        ...req
      };
      const tokenData = await pRetry(async () => {
        const { data, requestId } = await this.httpClient.request(
          // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
          token(payload4)
        );
        const result = tokenSchema.safeParse(data);
        if (result.success) {
          return result.data;
        }
        throw new CliError({
          code: InvalidResponseData(),
          cause: result.error,
          info: { requestId, data }
        });
      }, this.retryOptions);
      return {
        ...tokenData,
        issuedAt: getCurrentTimestamp()
      };

  RefreshTokenRevoked: (0, import_variant.fields)()
});
var AuthClient = class {
  constructor(httpClient) {
    this.httpClient = httpClient;
    const { minRetryTimeout } = getTestOverrides();
    this.retryOptions = {
      retries: 3,
      minTimeout: minRetryTimeout,
      maxTimeout: 3 * 1e3
    };
  }
  retryOptions;
  async requestDeviceCode(req = {}) {
    try {
      const { data } = await pRetry(
        () => this.httpClient.request(deviceCode({ ...req, clientId })),
        this.retryOptions
      );
      return deviceCodeSchema.parse(data);
    } catch (error) {
      throw new CliError({
        code: FailedToGetDeviceCode(),
        cause: error
      });
    }
  }
  async createToken(req) {
    try {
      const payload4 = {
        clientId,
        grantType: "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code",
        scope: "offline_access",
        ...req
      };
      const tokenData = await pRetry(async () => {
        const { data, requestId } = await this.httpClient.request(
          // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
          token(payload4)
        );
        const result = tokenSchema.safeParse(data);
        if (result.success) {
          return result.data;
        }
        throw new CliError({
          code: InvalidResponseData(),
          cause: result.error,
          info: { requestId, data }
        });
      }, this.retryOptions);
      return {
        ...tokenData,
        issuedAt: getCurrentTimestamp()
      };
    } catch (error) {
      if (isHttpError(error) && (error.response?.data?.message === "Device code is not yet verified" || // https://github.com/wix-private/wix-cli/pull/655#discussion_r1145992702
      error.response?.data?.error === "authorization_pending")) {
        throw new DeviceCodeNotYetVerifiedError(
          "Device code is not yet verified."
        );
      }
      throw new CliError({
        code: FailedToGetAuthToken(),
        cause: error
      });
    }
  }
  async renewToken(req) {
    try {
      const payload4 = {
        clientId,
        grantType: "refresh_token",
        ...req
      };
      const { data } = await pRetry(
        () => this.httpClient.request(
          // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
          token(payload4)
        ),
        this.retryOptions
      );
      const tokenData = tokenSchema.parse(data);
      return RenewTokenData.TokenRenewed({
        ...tokenData,
        issuedAt: getCurrentTimestamp()
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (isHttpError(error)) {
        if (error.response?.status === 400 && error.response.data?.error === "invalid_grant") {
          return RenewTokenData.RefreshTokenRevoked({ cause: error });
        }
        if (req.siteId && error.response?.status === 404 && isHttpApplicationError(error) && error.response.data.details.applicationError.code === "SITE_NOT_FOUND") {
          throw new CliError({
            code: FailedToRenewAuthTokenSiteNotFound({ siteId: req.siteId }),
            cause: error
          });
        }
      }
      throw new CliError({
        code: FailedToRenewAuthToken(),
        cause: error
      });
    }
  }
  async revokeRefreshToken(req, { email }) {
    try {
      const { data } = await this.httpClient.request(revokeRefreshToken(req));
      return data;
    } catch (error) {
      throw new CliError({
        code: FailedToRevokeRefreshToken({
          email
        }),
        info: {
          email
        },
        cause: error
      });
    }
  }
  async userInfo({ accessToken }) {
    try {
      const httpClient = createHttpClient({
        type: "backoffice",
        getAppToken: async () => accessToken
      });
      const { data: userInfoData } = await httpClient.get(
        "/_serverless/wix-cli-userinfo/userinfo"
      );
      return userInfoSchema.parse(userInfoData);
    } catch (error) {
      throw new CliError({
        code: CliErrorCode.FailedToGetUserInfo(),
        cause: error
      });
    }
  }

      const httpClient = createHttpClient({
        type: "backoffice",

FILE /tmp/wixcli/node_modules/@wix/cli/build/chunk-27EQV7T6.js LINE 15775
var resolveValue = Symbol("resolveValue");
async function pWaitFor(condition, options = {}) {
  const {
    interval = 20,
    timeout = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
    before = true
  } = options;
  let retryTimeout;
  let abort = false;
  const promise = new Promise((resolve2, reject) => {
    const check = async () => {
      try {
        const value = await condition();
        if (typeof value === "object" && value[resolveValue]) {
          resolve2(value[resolveValue]);
        } else if (typeof value !== "boolean") {
          throw new TypeError("Expected condition to return a boolean");
        } else if (value === true) {
          resolve2();
        } else if (!abort) {
          retryTimeout = setTimeout(check, interval);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        reject(error);
      }
    };
    if (before) {
      check();
    } else {
      retryTimeout = setTimeout(check, interval);
    }
  });
  if (timeout === Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY) {
    return promise;
  }
  try {
    return await pTimeout(promise, typeof timeout === "number" ? { milliseconds: timeout } : timeout);
  } finally {
    abort = true;
    clearTimeout(retryTimeout);
  }
}
pWaitFor.resolveWith = (value) => ({ [resolveValue]: value });

// ../cli-auth/src/auth-strategies/account-auth-strategy.ts
var seconds = (n) => 1e3 * n;
async function finalizeLogin(tokenData) {
  const userInfo = await client.userInfo({
    accessToken: tokenData.accessToken
  });
  const result = { ...tokenData, userInfo };
  await deleteAuthData();
  await saveAuthData(result);
  return result;
}
async function loginWithDeviceCode({ deviceCode: deviceCode2, expiresIn }, { signal }) {
  try {
    const authData = await pWaitFor(
      async () => {
        try {
          const tokenData = await client.createToken({
            deviceCode: deviceCode2
          });
          return pWaitFor.resolveWith(tokenData);
        } catch (error) {
          if (error instanceof DeviceCodeNotYetVerifiedError) {
            return false;
          }
          throw error;
        }
      },
      {
        interval: getTestOverrides().loginWithDeviceCodeInterval ?? seconds(3),
        timeout: { milliseconds: seconds(expiresIn), signal }
      }
    );
    return await finalizeLogin(authData);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof TimeoutError) {
      throw new CliError({
        code: CliErrorCode.DeviceCodeTimedOut(),
        cause: error
      });
    }
    throw error;
  }
}
async function loginWithRefreshToken({
  refreshToken
}) {
  const renewTokenResult = await client.renewToken({ refreshToken });
  if ((0, import_variant4.isType)(renewTokenResult, RenewTokenData.TokenRenewed)) {
    return await finalizeLogin(renewTokenResult.payload);
  }
  throw new CliError({
    code: CliErrorCode.FailedToLoginWithRefreshToken(),
    cause: null
  });
}
async function renewAccountAuth({
  refreshToken,
  userInfo
}) {
  const renewTokenResult = await client.renewToken({ refreshToken });
  if ((0, import_variant4.isType)(renewTokenResult, RenewTokenData.TokenRenewed)) {
    await saveAuthData({ ...renewTokenResult.payload, userInfo });
  }
  return renewTokenResult;
}
async function getNonExpiredAccountAuth() {
  const accountAuthStatus = await readAccountAuthData();
  return (0, import_variant4.match)(accountAuthStatus, {
    Authenticated: (accountAuth) => accountAuth,
    Unauthenticated: () => null,
    Expired: async (accountAuth) => {
      const renewTokenResult = await renewAccountAuth(accountAuth);
      return (0, import_variant4.match)(renewTokenResult, {
        TokenRenewed: ({ payload: newTokenData }) => ({
          ...newTokenData,
          userInfo: accountAuth.userInfo
        }),
        RefreshTokenRevoked: (0, import_variant4.constant)(null)
      });
    }
  });
}
function createAccountAuthState({
  userInfo,
  ...initialTokenData
}) {
  const limiter = pLimit(1);
  let tokenData = { ...initialTokenData };
  return {
    getAccessToken: () => {
      return limiter(async () => {
        if (isValidToken(tokenData)) {
          return tokenData.accessToken;
        }
        const renewTokenResult = await renewAccountAuth({
          ...tokenData,
          userInfo
        });
        return (0, import_variant4.match)(renewTokenResult, {
          TokenRenewed: ({ payload: newTokenData }) => {
            tokenData = newTokenData;
            return tokenData.accessToken;
          },
          RefreshTokenRevoked: ({ cause }) => {
            throw new CliError({
              code: CliErrorCode.FailedToRenewAuthTokenRefreshTokenRevoked(),
              cause
            });
          }
        });
      });
    },
    getRefreshToken: () => tokenData.refreshToken,
    userInfo
  };
}
var accountAuthStrategy = {
  async isLoggedIn() {
    const apiKeyAuth = await apiKeyAuthStrategy.isLoggedIn();
    if (apiKeyAuth) {
      return apiKeyAuth;
    }
    const accountAuth = await getNonExpiredAccountAuth();
    if (accountAuth) {
      return createAccountAuthState(accountAuth);
    }
    return null;
  },
  async login({ deviceCode: deviceCode2, signal }) {
    const accountAuth = await loginWithDeviceCode(deviceCode2, { signal });
    return createAccountAuthState(accountAuth);
  }
};

// ../cli-auth/src/auth-strategies/unified-auth-strategy.ts
async function createAuthState({
  userInfo,
  ...initialTokenData
}) {
  const limiter = pLimit(1);
  let accountTokenData = { ...initialTokenData };
  const siteTokensDataCache = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  async function getOrEnsureSiteAuth(siteId) {
    const cached = siteTokensDataCache.get(siteId);
    if (cached && isValidToken(cached)) {
      return cached;
    }
    const siteAuthResult = await ensureAuthenticatedToSite({
      siteId,
      accountRefreshToken: accountTokenData.refreshToken
    });
    if (!(0, import_variant6.isType)(siteAuthResult, AuthenticationResult.Ok)) {
      throw new CliError({
        code: CliErrorCode.FailedToRenewAuthTokenRefreshTokenRevoked(),
        cause: siteAuthResult.cause
      });
    }
    const siteTokenData = siteAuthResult.payload;
    siteTokensDataCache.set(siteId, siteTokenData);
    return siteTokenData;
  }
  return {
    getAccessToken: ({ siteId } = {}) => {
      return limiter(async () => {
        if (siteId) {
          return (await getOrEnsureSiteAuth(siteId)).accessToken;
        }
        if (isValidToken(accountTokenData)) {
          return accountTokenData.accessToken;
        }
        const renewTokenResult = await renewAccountAuth({
          ...accountTokenData,
          userInfo
        });
        return (0, import_variant6.match)(renewTokenResult, {
          TokenRenewed: ({ payload: newTokenData }) => {
            accountTokenData = newTokenData;
            return accountTokenData.accessToken;
          },
          RefreshTokenRevoked: ({ cause }) => {
            throw new CliError({
              code: CliErrorCode.FailedToRenewAuthTokenRefreshTokenRevoked(),
              cause
            });
          }
        });
      });
    },
    getRefreshToken: () => accountTokenData.refreshToken,
    userInfo
  };
}
var unifiedAuthStrategy = {
  async isLoggedIn() {
    const apiKeyAuth = await apiKeyAuthStrategy.isLoggedIn();
    if (apiKeyAuth) {
      return apiKeyAuth;
    }
    const accountAuth = await getNonExpiredAccountAuth();
    if (!accountAuth) {
      return null;
    }
    return await createAuthState(accountAuth);
  },
  async login({ deviceCode: deviceCode2, signal }) {
    const accountAuth = await loginWithDeviceCode(deviceCode2, {
      signal
    });
    return await createAuthState(accountAuth);
  },
  async loginWithRefreshToken({ refreshToken }) {
    const authData = await loginWithRefreshToken({ refreshToken });
    return await createAuthState(authData);
  }
};

var import_variant7 = __toESM(require_lib(), 1);
async function logout() {
  const authData = await readAccountAuthData();
  if (!(0, import_variant7.isType)(authData, AccountAuthData.Unauthenticated)) {
    await client.revokeRefreshToken(
      { token: authData.refreshToken },
      authData.userInfo
    );
  }
  await deleteAuthData();
  return null;
}

var unifiedAuthStrategy = {
  async isLoggedIn() {
    const apiKeyAuth = await apiKeyAuthStrategy.isLoggedIn();
    if (apiKeyAuth) {
      return apiKeyAuth;
    }
    const accountAuth = await getNonExpiredAccountAuth();
    if (!accountAuth) {
      return null;
    }
    return await createAuthState(accountAuth);
  },

      signal
    });
    return await createAuthState(accountAuth);
  },
  async loginWithRefreshToken({ refreshToken }) {
    const authData = await loginWithRefreshToken({ refreshToken });
    return await createAuthState(authData);
  }
};

async function logout() {
  const authData = await readAccountAuthData();
  if (!(0, import_variant7.isType)(authData, AccountAuthData.Unauthenticated)) {
    await client.revokeRefreshToken(
      { token: authData.refreshToken },
      authData.userInfo
    );
  }
  await deleteAuthData();
  return null;
}

// ../cli-auth/src/verfication-uri.ts
init_esm_shims();
function buildVerificationUris(verificationUri) {
  const coloredUri = new URL(verificationUri);
  coloredUri.searchParams.set("color", "developer");
  coloredUri.searchParams.set("studio", "true");
  const signupUri = new URL("https://users.wix.com/login/signup/password");
  signupUri.searchParams.set("redirectTo", coloredUri.href);
  signupUri.searchParams.set("referralInfo", "cli");
  coloredUri.searchParams.set("referralInfo", "cli");
  return {
    coloredVerificationUri: coloredUri.toString(),
    signupUri: signupUri.toString()
  };
}

// ../cli-auth/src/agent-auth.ts
function emitLoginFlowMessage(event) {
  console.log(`${JSON.stringify(event)}
`);
}
function createAwaitingUserLoginFlowMessage(deviceCode2) {
  const { coloredVerificationUri } = buildVerificationUris(
    deviceCode2.verificationUri
  );
  return {
    event: "awaiting_user",
    expiresInSeconds: deviceCode2.expiresIn,
    userCode: deviceCode2.userCode,
    verificationUri: coloredVerificationUri
  };
}
function createLoggedInLoginFlowMessage(userInfo) {
  return {
    email: userInfo.email,
    event: "logged_in",
    userId: userInfo.userId
  };
}
function createSuccessfulLoginFlowMessage(userInfo) {
  return {
    email: userInfo.email,
    event: "success",
    userId: userInfo.userId
  };
}
async function runAgentLoginFlow({
  biLogger,
  loginFn = unifiedAuthStrategy.login,
  signal = new AbortController().signal
}) {
  reportLoginStart(biLogger);
  try {
    const deviceCode2 = await requestDeviceCode();
    emitLoginFlowMessage(createAwaitingUserLoginFlowMessage(deviceCode2));
    const authData = await loginFn({
      deviceCode: deviceCode2,
      signal
    });
    reportLoginSuccess(biLogger, authData.userInfo);
    emitLoginFlowMessage(createSuccessfulLoginFlowMessage(authData.userInfo));
    return authData;
  } catch (error) {
    reportLoginFailure(biLogger, error);
    throw error;
  }
}

// ../cli-debug-log/src/index.tsx
init_esm_shims();
var import_react7 = __toESM(require_react(), 1);
var import_verror = __toESM(require_verror(), 1);
import { dirname as dirname2 } from "node:path";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
function writeCrashReport(reportPath, error, occurredAt) {
  try {
    let content = `----- CLI crash report at ${occurredAt.toISOString()}
`;
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      content += `Error Trace
`;
      content += `${import_verror.default.fullStack(error)}
`;
      content += `Error Info
`;
      content += `${JSON.stringify(import_verror.default.info(error), null, 2)}
`;
      const httpError = extractHttpError(error);
      if (httpError) {
        content += `Request Info
`;
        content += `${JSON.stringify(getHttpErrorInfo(httpError), null, 2)}
`;
      }
    }
    mkdirSync(dirname2(reportPath), { recursive: true });
    appendFileSync(reportPath, content);
  } catch {
  }
}
var DebugLogContext = (0, import_react7.createContext)(null);
var DebugLogProvider = ({ filePath, children }) => {
  const writeToDebugLog = (0, import_react7.useCallback)(
    (error) => writeCrashReport(filePath, error, /* @__PURE__ */ new Date()),
    [filePath]
  );
